findings.issue: The base URL is double‑escaped before being injected into the client script. `replace(/"/g, "\\\"")` removes quotes, then `JSON.stringify` adds another layer of quoting, resulting in `window.__OMNIBRIDGE_BASE_URL__ = "\"https://...\"";` which yields an invalid value and breaks any code that reads this global.

API route definitions are missing a leading slash (e.g., `route("api/v1/chat/completions", ...)`). This causes the router to treat them as relative paths, potentially leading to 404 responses for API calls.
findings.fix:
Add a leading slash to each API route path.
```ts
export default [
  index("routes/landing.tsx"),
  route("/auth", "routes/auth.tsx"),
  route("/logout", "routes/logout.tsx"),
  route("/api/v1/chat/completions", "routes/api.v1.chat.completions.ts"),
  route("/api/v1/models", "routes/api.v1.models.ts"),
  // ... rest unchanged
] satisfies RouteConfig;
```
